newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's First International may issue $100m bond.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's First International may issue $100m bond.

text.p: Taiwan's First International Computer said on Tuesday it may issue US$100 million worth of convertible bonds at the end of December to raise general operational funds.
"We are contemplating such an issue and we will have a final decision tomorrow (Wednesday) whether or not to make the issue," a company spokeswoman said by telephone.
First International would probably use funds raised from the issue to strengthen its general operations, she said.
First International is Taiwan's second-biggest computer maker.
